'''MacDougal''', also known as '''"Black Jack" MacDougal''', was a [[Binayre Pirates|Binayre pirate]] who lived in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:E" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] forces commanded by [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] [[Ceth Laike]] initiated a series of strikes against the Binayre Pirates in retaliation for the assassination of a [[TIE pilot]] on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. After several skirmishes on Talus and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Imperial pilots attacked a group of Binayre pirates in Corellian space. The pirate group counted five [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], including an [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]] piloted by the [[Squadron Leader/Legends|squadron leader]] "Black Jack" MacDougal. In the ensuring battle, all pirate vessels were destroyed and MacDougal was killed.<ref name="SWG:E" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempGenericPirate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of "Black Jack" MacDougal]]
MacDougal appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:E" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> "Black Jack" MacDougal was added to the game with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Update Notes: March 24, 2005|Publish 14.1]], on [[March 24]], [[2005]].<ref name="P14.1">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=734|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.1 - March 24, 2005}}</ref>
